title: DucklakeConnection
description: DuckLake is an open Lakehouse format that is built on SQL and Parquet

metadataPath.title: Metadata Path
metadataPath.description: DuckLake metadata catalog path or connection string. Examples: metadata.ducklake, postgres:dbname=postgres, or a DuckDB secret name.

dataPath.title: Data Path
dataPath.description: Optional DuckLake data storage location. Examples: s3://bucket/path/ or /path/to/files/.

catalogName.title: Catalog Name
catalogName.description: Catalog name used to attach DuckLake in DuckDB.

databaseName.title: Database Name
databaseName.description: Optional name to give to the database in OpenMetadata. If left blank, the attached catalog name is used.

databaseSchema.title: Database Schema
databaseSchema.description: Database Schema of the data source. This is optional parameter, if you would like to restrict the metadata reading to a single schema.

createIfNotExists.title: Create If Not Exists
createIfNotExists.description: Create a new DuckLake if the configured metadata catalog does not exist.

overrideDataPath.title: Override Data Path
overrideDataPath.description: Override the data path stored in DuckLake metadata for this connection.

awsConfig.title: S3 Credentials Configuration
awsConfig.description: Optional credentials used by DuckDB to read DuckLake catalogs or data paths in S3-compatible object storage. Leave empty for public HTTPS catalogs.

schemaFilterPattern.title: Default Schema Filter Pattern
schemaFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude schemas that matches the pattern.

tableFilterPattern.title: Default Table Filter Pattern
tableFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude tables that matches the pattern.

databaseFilterPattern.title: Default Database Filter Pattern
databaseFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude databases that matches the pattern.
